title: kasdan co. — Food & Drink Photography
summary: Seasonal menu photography for our café, shot outdoors with a bit of humour.
overview: We photograph the menu at kasdan co., our café in Sault Ste. Marie, each season. Instead of a plain backdrop we usually take the drinks and donuts outside — the autumn woods, a garden, an iron fence.

cover.alt: A person in a white bedsheet ghost costume and sunglasses peeks out from behind a tree in autumn woods, holding an iced latte decorated with little ghost faces

idea.heading: The approach
body: We try to let each photo say something about the item. The Halloween latte has ghosts on the cup, so ghosts are holding it. The fall donuts sit on a fence under a maple tree.
Each shoot is planned for where the photos will be used: menu boards, Instagram, Reels covers and ads.

execution.heading: What's included
body: Styling, an on-location shoot, edited photos in square, portrait and vertical crops, and short clips for Stories and TikTok.
